# key: # ---- Emulator window mode (M7): window devices, the binding wizard, saved profiles. Prefix: Window_ ----

zh-CN: 模拟器窗口未在捕获。请在“设备”页点击“开始捕获”。
en-US: The emulator window is not being captured. Click "Start capture" on the Devices page.

zh-CN: 找不到匹配的窗口。请确认模拟器已启动且窗口未最小化，然后点击“重新连接”。
en-US: No matching window found. Make sure the emulator is running and not minimized, then click "Reconnect".

zh-CN: 此模拟器窗口没有关联 adb 设备，只能截图和识别，不能点击或输入。请在“设备”页编辑档案并关联 adb 设备。
en-US: This emulator window has no linked adb device: it can be captured and matched but not tapped or typed into. Edit the profile on the Devices page and link an adb device.

zh-CN: 关联的 adb 设备 {0} 未连接，无法输入。
en-US: The linked adb device {0} is not connected, so input is unavailable.

zh-CN: 当前模拟器窗口没有关联 adb 设备，无法执行 shell 命令。
en-US: The current emulator window has no linked adb device, so shell commands cannot run.

zh-CN: 模拟器窗口设备不支持此操作（需要 scrcpy 控制通道）。
en-US: Emulator window devices do not support this action (it needs the scrcpy control channel).

zh-CN: 点击右上角“绑定模拟器窗口”，把模拟器窗口当作设备使用：画面来自窗口截图，输入走关联的 adb 设备。
en-US: Click "Bind emulator window" above to use an emulator window as a device: the picture comes from the window, input goes through the linked adb device.

zh-CN: 确定删除“{0}”吗？对应的窗口设备会从设备列表中移除。
en-US: Remove "{0}"? Its window device disappears from the device list.

zh-CN: 选择模拟器的主窗口。右侧是实时缩略图，用来确认选对了窗口。
en-US: Choose the emulator's main window. The live thumbnail on the right confirms it is the right one.

zh-CN: 在截图上拖出 Android 画面所在的矩形，去掉模拟器的标题栏、工具栏和边框；画面占满窗口时可直接使用整个客户区。
en-US: Drag a rectangle around the Android screen on the capture to leave out the emulator's title bar, toolbar and borders; use the whole client area when the screen fills the window.

zh-CN: 关联 adb 设备后可以点击和输入；参考分辨率是画面对应的 Android 屏幕分辨率，所有坐标都按它换算。
en-US: Link an adb device to tap and type; the reference resolution is the Android screen resolution the picture shows, and all coordinates are expressed in it.

zh-CN: 为档案命名。下次启动时按匹配规则重新找到这个窗口。
en-US: Name the profile. The match rule finds the window again next time.
Choose a window on the left

zh-CN: 不裁剪，使用整个客户区
en-US: No crop: use the whole client area

zh-CN: 还没有窗口画面。请返回上一步确认缩略图正常显示。
en-US: No picture of the window yet. Go back and check that the thumbnail shows.

zh-CN: 还没有窗口画面。请返回上一步确认缩略图正常显示。
en-US: No picture of the window yet. Go back and check that the thumbnail shows.
The selected area is too small.

zh-CN: 关联 adb 设备（可选）
点击、滑动和按键通过这台 adb 设备发送。不关联时只能截图和识别。
en-US: Taps, swipes and keys are sent through this adb device. Without one the window can only be captured and matched.

zh-CN: 选择 adb 设备后会自动读取其屏幕分辨率，并按画面方向调整；也可以手动填写。留空表示直接使用画面像素。
en-US: Read automatically from the adb device's screen (oriented like the picture) once a device is chosen; you can also type it. Leave empty to use picture pixels.

zh-CN: 画面 {0}×{1} 将映射到设备坐标 {2}×{3}。
en-US: The {0}×{1} picture maps to device coordinates {2}×{3}.

zh-CN: 未设置参考分辨率：设备坐标等于画面像素（{0}×{1}）。
en-US: No reference resolution: device coordinates equal picture pixels ({0}×{1}).

zh-CN: 注意：宽高比与画面不一致，请检查画面区域是否框选准确。
en-US: Note: the aspect ratio differs from the picture; check that the screen area is accurate.
Could not read the device resolution: {0}

zh-CN: 填写的条件都满足的窗口才会被使用（标题为包含匹配，不区分大小写）。标题里有会变化的内容时可以删掉那部分。
en-US: A window is used only when every filled-in condition matches (title: case-insensitive substring). Remove parts of the title that change.

zh-CN: 画面区域：{0}    参考分辨率：{1}    输入：{2}
